camera: Flat front-facing 2D UI over a strictly top-down painted terrain map; no perspective.

spatialRatios.characterScreenHeight: 1/8 of screen height (each hero portrait in the roster)
spatialRatios.renderingTechnique: hand-painted 2D card portraits over flat-graphic top-down terrain map, framed by programmatic 9-slice UI chrome

hudLayout.topThird: 0-8%: stone-grey header: chapter book with gold '2' and 'CHAPTER'; counters gold hex coin '10K', green star '2K', pink meeple '37'; 6-segment quest bar with 3 segments filled grey, gold '0/6'. 8-15%: walnut wood strip: quest scroll left, quest scroll right (red wax seals with yellow '!'), centre a khaki raised panel with a big yellow up-arrow, 'UPGRADE' over 'CARDS', and a dark progress bar '0/1'. 16-19%: khaki tab bar: wide selected tab with farm cottage icon and 'LOCAL FARM'; four dark grey locked tabs with black silhouettes. 19-44%: top-down terrain map with a single empty grey hero slot centred (white plus) on a plum base.
hudLayout.middleThird: 44-49%: khaki header strip: left 'Heroes' in white bold with 'Hold a hero and drag it onto a slot' beneath in smaller cream text; right a lime-olive 'DONE' button. 50-71%: dark navy field with three equal hero cards in a row, each a tall portrait over a dark charcoal plate with name, 'Level 1' and green 'Free'; small square power icon tile at the portrait's bottom-right corner. Card 1 Urlith: purple storm dwarf wizard, blue lightning power icon. Card 2 Sylaei: red-lit grinning golden-haired elf warrior, orange slash power icon. Card 3 Bram: young human adventurer in chainmail with round wooden shield, sky light, golden sword power icon; this card is selected with a thick gold frame and olive-gold plate.
hudLayout.bottomThird: 71-94% empty dark navy field. 94-100% walnut wood footer: card-deck collection button left (stacked cards with a henchman face), wooden treasure chest with a bouncing yellow '!' right of centre, steel cog settings button far right, 'username' centre, debug 'fps: 59.95' far left.

keyElements: header with chapter book and counters
UPGRADE CARDS panel between two quest scrolls
single empty hero slot on map
footer with card deck, chest, cog
uiStyle: Chunky 9-slice slabs: stone grey header, khaki tabs and strips, lime DONE button, charcoal name plates, gold selection frame; crisp clean edges and uniform card spacing; white bold sans text with green 'Free'.

lighting.shadowCharacter: soft gradient falloff in portraits; hard offset shadows under buttons
lighting.highlightType: soft satin highlights on portraits, small warm glints on slab rims
lighting.ambient: each portrait flooded in its own hue (purple, red, sky blue)

colorPalette: Warm khaki/grey/walnut chrome, olive-teal map, three strongly coloured portraits (purple, crimson, sky) on dark navy, gold selection accent.
composition: Upper map with one target slot draws a line down to the hero roster; gold-framed Bram card is the focal point.

content.slot: one empty hero slot with plus

strip.title: Heroes
strip.hint: Hold a hero and drag it onto a slot
